# Appropriation Ordinance No. 01, Series of 2010 (Supplemental Budget #01)

**Resolution No. 086 — Supplemental Budget #01 — P2,254,664.82**

**Introduced by: Coun. [[John Paul H. Bunag]]**

> [!note] Duplicate Ordinance Number
> This is a second Appro. Ordinance No. 01 for 2010, distinct from the January pre-closing budget ([[AO-01-S2010]]). This supplemental budget was enacted under the new SB term that began mid-2010.

## Summary

This appropriation ordinance enacts Supplemental Budget No. 01 for fiscal year 2010, appropriating the total amount of P2,254,664.82 for additional expenditures of the Municipality of [[Pitogo]], Quezon. Introduced by Councilor [[John Paul H. Bunag]], this was enacted under the new Sangguniang Bayan composition that took office mid-2010 following the May 2010 elections.

## Key Provisions

1. **Appropriation**: The amount of P2,254,664.82 is hereby appropriated as Supplemental Budget No. 01 for fiscal year 2010.

2. **Source of Funds**: The supplemental budget is sourced from savings and other authorized revenue sources in accordance with the Local Government Code.

3. **Effectivity**: Takes effect upon approval.

## New SB Composition (Mid-2010 Term)

This ordinance was enacted under the new Sangguniang Bayan composition following the May 2010 elections:
